hooks.name: milestone-verification
hooks.description: After each agent turn, run the smoke subset (127 fast contract tests, about 4 s; no GPU, rollouts or network). Always exits 0 so a failure is reported rather than triggering another turn. The complete fast + integration suites, lint and web build are the mandatory milestone check: scripts/milestone_check.sh.

action.command: uv run --frozen --offline pytest -q -m 'smoke and not integration' -p no:cacheprovider; echo "milestone-verification (smoke subset; full suite: scripts/milestone_check.sh): pytest exit code $?"; exit 0
